name: Oculoplastics Outlook
description: Ptosis, entropion/ectropion, chalazion/hordeolum, lacrimal obstruction, thyroid eye disease, orbital fractures, periocular tumors, and blepharoplasty.

episodes.title: Eyelid Anatomy: The Seven Layers and the Surgical Planes
episodes.description: From skin to tarsus to conjunctiva — the layers that guide every lid surgery and injection.

episodes.title: Ptosis: The MRD and the Levator Function
episodes.description: The margin-reflex distance, the levator excursion, and the congenital versus aponeurotic distinction.

episodes.title: Involutional Ptosis: The Aging Levator
episodes.description: The disinsertion, the thinning, the surgical repair, and the bilateral even if unilateral presentation.

episodes.title: Congenital Ptosis: The Levator Dysgenesis
episodes.description: The poor levator function, the lid lag, and the amblyopia risk and surgical timing in infants.

episodes.title: Horner Syndrome and the Ptotic Pupil
episodes.description: The miosis, the anhidrosis, and the localization and imaging that the combination demands.

episodes.title: Myasthenia Gravis: The Variable Ptosis
episodes.description: The fatigability, the ice test, and the systemic workup that the lid sign triggers.

episodes.title: Entropion: The In-Turned Lid and the Trichiasis
episodes.description: The involutional and cicatricial forms, the lashes that abrade, and the surgical repair.

episodes.title: Ectropion: The Out-Turned Lid and the Epiphora
episodes.description: The punctal eversion, the tearing, and the horizontal and medial canthal tightening.

episodes.title: Trichiasis: The Misdirected Lash Without Lid Malposition
episodes.description: The epilation, electrolysis, cryotherapy, and argon laser options and the recurrence that frustrates.

episodes.title: Chalazion: The Chronic Lipogranuloma
episodes.description: The obstructed meibomian gland, the warm compress and intralesional steroid, and the surgery threshold.

episodes.title: Hordeolum: The Acute Abscess of the Lid
episodes.description: The external and internal stye, the antibiotics, and the drainage that rarely follows.

episodes.title: Blepharitis: Anterior and Posterior, The Inflammation
episodes.description: The staphylococcal, seborrheic, and MGD forms and the lid hygiene that is the foundation of care.

episodes.title: Basal Cell Carcinoma: The Most Common Lid Malignancy
episodes.description: The pearly nodule, the telangiectasia, the biopsy, and the Mohs surgery that spares tissue.

episodes.title: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Lid
episodes.description: The scaling lesion, the faster growth, and the wider excision and lymph node surveillance.

episodes.title: Sebaceous Cell Carcinoma: The Masquerader
episodes.description: The recurrent chalazion, the pagetoid spread, and the map biopsy and aggressive surgery.

episodes.title: Melanoma of the Lid: The ABCDE and the Biopsy
episodes.description: The changing pigmentation, the shave versus excisional, and the sentinel node and surveillance.

episodes.title: Lacrimal System Anatomy: From Punctum to Nose
episodes.description: The canaliculus, the sac, the nasolacrimal duct, and the obstruction sites that cause tearing.

episodes.title: Nasolacrimal Duct Obstruction: The Adult Epiphora
episodes.description: The dye disappearance, the irrigation, and the DCR that resolves the chronic tearing.

episodes.title: Dacryocystitis: The Infected Sac
episodes.description: The painful swelling, the discharge, the antibiotics, and the DCR after the infection clears.

episodes.title: Thyroid Eye Disease: The Proptosis and the Optic Nerve
episodes.description: The orbital inflammation, the restrictive myopathy, and the urgent optic neuropathy risk.

episodes.title: Orbital Cellulitis: Behind the Septum and in the Orbit
episodes.description: The CT, the IV antibiotics, and the surgical drainage of the abscess that threatens vision.

episodes.title: Orbital Fractures: The Blowout and the Diplopia
episodes.description: The floor fracture, the entrapped inferior rectus, and the surgical timing and observation.

episodes.title: Orbital Tumors: The Differential and the Imaging
episodes.description: From cavernous hemangioma to lymphoma — the MRI, the biopsy, and the multidisciplinary approach.

episodes.title: Blepharoplasty: The Functional and the Cosmetic
episodes.description: The dermatochalasis that obstructs vision, the visual field test, and the surgery that restores.

episodes.title: Eyelid Laceration: The Repair at the Chair and the OR
episodes.description: The margin involvement, the canalicular injury, and the layered closure that prevents notching.

episodes.title: Bell’s Palsy: The Lid That Cannot Close
episodes.description: The exposure keratopathy, the lubrication and taping, and the recovery timeline and gold weight.

episodes.title: Dry Eye and the Lacrimal System: The Paradox
episodes.description: When tearing signals dry eye — the reflex hypersecretion and the diagnostic and treatment puzzle.

episodes.title: Cosmetic Injectables: Botox and Fillers Around the Eye
episodes.description: The glabellar lines, the periocular filler, and the complications — migration and blindness — to avoid.

episodes.title: Pediatric Oculoplastics: The Congenital Anomalies
episodes.description: Coloboma, epiblepharon, and ptosis — the infant lid findings and the surgical timing.

episodes.title: The Oculoplastics Referral: What to Send and When
episodes.description: The triage of lid, lacrimal, and orbit — the urgent, the elective, and the shared care plan.
